Version 0.2.6 - MDBList source: user, top 50 public, official, and external lists via API key - Trakt: added popular and trending public lists alongside user lists - "Allow Community Lists" toggle for Trakt and MDBList (off by default) - Removed IMDB source (replaced by MDBList) - Fixed Trakt season items not being added to playlists - Fixed service tight-loop when Run Every Hours is set to 0 (Disabled) - Fixed thread-safety and item ordering in library matching; sequential Run_All builds - Fixed OpenRouter Clear Build Time action and missing-arg launch crash - Fixed Mixed (PseudoTV) playlist path when parent path contains "video"
Version 0.2.4 - Playlists keep the order the source API returns items in
Version 0.2.3 - OpenRouter AI module: natural-language prompts build smartplaylists - model picker, AI proofreading, manual rules, auto-rebuild - Trakt person credits: per-person Movies / TV Shows playlists from cast - Unique-id matching wins; title matches must agree on year; episodes match by show+season+episode - File-name collision handling; auto Container.Refresh after builds - Stale build lock auto-expires; failed builds no longer record timestamps; missing XSP files rebuilt on auto-runs
